name: skeleton
behavior: None — presentational placeholder. The placeholder itself is aria-hidden and the region it stands in for carries aria-busy=true, so assistive tech announces one loading status instead of reading a wall of empty shapes. It is never focusable and must not shift layout when the real content arrives.

parts.note: one placeholder shape; the caller supplies its size, and radius-pill is substituted for text lines — a recipe choice on the same part

anatomyNotes: Salt has no skeleton — it expresses pending work with Spinner, so the Salt translation falls back to anatomy/progress.json (indeterminate) per contract/variants.md §Fallback ladder. loading is the only state: a skeleton has no rest, because at rest it does not exist. The pulse is the loading state's motion recipe (states.md §loading), damped to nothing under prefers-reduced-motion.
